summary:
- Updated Offertory Offline Cap upgrade (offertoryCapLevel) to start at 2h 00m (120 min) at Lv. 0 and expand by +30m per level with no upper level cap (120 + offertoryCapLevel * 30 minutes).
- Added 1x | 10x | MAX batch selector, progressive elemental orb cost summation (floor(30 * 1.18^(Lv - 1))), MAX bulk confirmation dialog, and Xh YYm -> Zh WWm previews (e.g. 2h 00m -> 2h 30m, 7h 00m -> 7h 30m, 24h 00m -> 24h 30m) to the Offline Cap card alongside Consecration Rate.
- Removed upper level and banked-seconds clamps in StorageService, PlayGamesService Cloud Save, and GameController so both offertoryRateLevel and offertoryCapLevel persist permanently across defeats, Week 40 timeouts, and Forfeit Run resets at arbitrarily high levels (Lv. 20+, Lv. 50+).
- Synchronized live Offertory progress bar, FULL badge, Welcome Back offline harvest modal, WorldMap badge, and local notification rescheduling with the dynamic uncapped duration.
- Updated en/pt/es/de localizations and verified with flutter analyze (0 issues) and full flutter test suite (461/461 passing).
